The '''Qektoth Confederation starfighter''' was employed by the [[Qektoth Confederation]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Based on [[Hyrotii Corporation/Legends|Hyrotii Corporation's]] [[Zebra starfighter]], the fighter was heavily modified by the Confederation for their needs. Chief among the modifications was the addition of a [[bio-plasmatic gel launcher]], which carried a magazine of three [[bio-plasmatic gel torpedo]]es. The fighters could be carried aboard [[Qektoth attack cruiser]]s.
